features.summary: AGENT_PROMPTS.md §2 feasibility-persona self-review gains a symmetric add-side test-gate closure paragraph immediately after the existing remove-side paragraph. The new paragraph instructs the planner: for every NEWLY CREATED file in File Structure matching a gate-runnable glob (per the profile's Build & test gates Test command), the project's learned-rules/<slug>/project-profile.md MUST also appear in File Structure with a task updating the gate command — missing profile is a P0 plan-completeness defect. ENG-122 is the worked-example anchor (mirrors the existing ENG-94 worked example for the remove-side). bin/agent-prompts-content-test.sh gains one new §2-scoped assertion (AND-joined grep on 'NEWLY CREATED' + 'learned-rules/<slug>/project-profile.md').
